question: After resolving the current main conflict, should maintainers land this structured no-dispatch cron failure path with focused validation, or wait for live Telegram proof first?
rationale: The implementation direction is backed by related maintainer guidance, but the branch is protected/maintainer-labeled, currently conflicting, and changes delivery/session-state behavior that maintainers must intentionally accept.

options.title: Refresh And Land With Focused Proof
options.body: Rebase or merge current main, preserve cron delivery-awareness behavior, rerun the focused cron and embedded-runner validation, and proceed if review remains clean.

options.title: Refresh Then Require Telegram Proof
options.body: Resolve conflicts and hold merge until Mantis or equivalent live Telegram evidence shows the self-debug text is not sent to the topic.

options.title: Pause For Alternate Fix
options.body: Keep this PR open but choose a different maintainer-owned implementation only if refresh reveals the bypass approach no longer fits current main.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Land With Focused Proof
recommendation.body: Rebase or merge current main, preserve cron delivery-awareness behavior, rerun the focused cron and embedded-runner validation, and proceed if review remains clean.
